Introducing ATHENA

Never let a dream slip away

A soft sleep band that reads your dreaming mind and reconstructs it as a short clip — waiting for you when you wake.

Join the Waitlist
12,000+ dreamers on the waitlist

From REM to replay, in three passes

ATHENA works quietly while you sleep, and does the hard part before your alarm goes off.

Capture

Dry EEG sensors along the band and ear-cups read neural activity through every sleep stage, without waking you.

Reconstruct

On-device AI maps dream-state signal patterns to visual and emotional motifs, entirely offline while you rest.

Replay

Wake up to a short reconstructed clip in the companion app — an impression of the dream, not a transcript of it.

Built to disappear into sleep

Every material choice serves one goal: forget you're wearing it by minute two.

9-hour battery

A full night of continuous sensing on one charge, with a 15-minute top-up dock.

On-device privacy

Reconstruction happens locally. Raw neural data never leaves the device unencrypted.

Soft-touch comfort

Heathered fabric band with a hypoallergenic lining, shaped to sleep in any position.

Companion app

Your dream archive, sleep trends, and clip library, organized automatically by night.

Sleep-stage tracking

Live REM, light, and deep-sleep detection tunes capture sensitivity through the night.

Wakes with you

A gentle haptic pulse instead of sound, timed to your lightest sleep window.

Before you ask

The questions everyone has the first time they hear about ATHENA.

No. ATHENA reads broad neural signal patterns during sleep, not language or specific thoughts. It reconstructs mood, motion, and color, not a transcript of what you were thinking.

Reconstructions are impressions, not recordings. In beta testing, most sleepers rated their clip's emotional tone and setting as recognizable, even when specific details differed from memory.

Reconstruction runs entirely on-device. Nothing leaves ATHENA unencrypted, and you choose whether a clip is ever saved to the companion app or deleted at sunrise.

The band is heathered fabric, not rigid plastic, with a hypoallergenic lining and a thin metal strap over the crown for stability. Most sleepers stop noticing it within a few nights.
